verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Figma's editor (layout and type tools) and multiplayer collaboration, but nothing in the pack describes a free tier or says these features are available without a paid seat. The pricing-page snippets (unlimited files for a single team, publishing across teams, admin tools, advanced Dev Mode) are not attributed to a free plan. Collaboration features with no stated plan cannot be credited to a free-tier story.

support.subject: As a designer, the free tier supports real design work — usable editor and collaboration without a paid seat
